'''Jeela Cthon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Jeela was married to [[Geo Cthon]] and together, they owned and operated ''[[Lucky You]]'', a service that used amateur actors to allow people to pretend that they had a better life. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] visited ''Lucky You'' and when he left, Cthon saw him putting his helmet on and getting on [[Garth Ezzar's speeder bike|his speeder bike]]. She realized that Ezzar would kill her if he knew that she had seen him, so she kept the knowledge to herself.
